"''It's okay that you're here.|FN-0606 and Rey|}} '''FN-0606''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[First Order]]'s [[FN Trooper Corps|FN Corps]] as a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] in [[35 ABY]].According to ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] take place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. The Hosnian Cataclysm was dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' meaning Episode IX, in which FN-0606 appears, takes place in [[35 ABY]]. When [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] arrived on the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']] to rescue [[Chewbacca]], the young [[Jedi]] confused FN-0606 and [[FN-1226|another stormtrooper]] with a [[mind trick]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== FN-0606 first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. He was played by actor [[Dave Hearn]], who appeared in the J.J. Abrams-produced play ''The Play That Goes Wrong''.{{Twitter|Graceybrook|status/1211782866293661697|Sweet Dumbass|quote=This is very important Dave, are you one of the Stormtroopers that Rey does the Jedi mind trick on????|archiveurl=https://archive.is/wJljO}}
